result.summary: Deprecates the `encryptwallet` RPC method for encrypting existing wallets, requiring `-deprecatedrpc=encryptwallet` to invoke the call ahead of future removal. Updates documentation to advise creating encrypted wallets upfront via `createwallet(passphrase=...)` and refactors functional tests to avoid post-creation wallet encryption.
result.problem: Encrypting an existing unencrypted wallet is hazardous: residual unencrypted key material is left on storage media (especially SSDs), generating new HD seeds post-encryption invalidates pre-encryption backups (risking fund loss), and encrypting wallets with imported descriptors can silently alter spending conditions.
evidence: PR description cites #26607: 'Encrypting a wallet that has manually imported descriptors will cause the wallet to change the spending conditions out from under the user.'

PR description highlights that 'Because new keys are made after encryption, restoring from a backup made before encryption may result in loss of funds' and notes that erasing plaintext key remnants on SSDs is infeasible.
result.scope_notes: Most of the diff consists of mechanical functional test updates that switch from `encryptwallet` to initializing wallets with a passphrase via `createwallet`.
result.changed_since_previous: No substantial changes to the approach or scope; the deprecation mechanism and test suite migrations remain the same across rebases.
result.card: Deprecates the encryptwallet RPC method for encrypting existing unencrypted wallets, requiring the -deprecatedrpc=encryptwallet configuration flag ahead of complete removal in a future release. Encrypting an already existing wallet risks fund loss because new keys invalidate older backups, leaves unencrypted key fragments on disk, and can silently alter spending conditions on wallets with imported descriptors (#26607). Wallets can still be encrypted upon creation via createwallet. Existing functional tests are adjusted to initialize encrypted wallets directly.

risk.why: External tooling and scripts relying on encryptwallet without passing -deprecatedrpc will fail with an RPC method deprecation error.
